title: Sushi, Salads, BBQ and Cheese Boards: Pregnancy Food-Safety Analysis
excerpt: Analyzing food safety for pregnant women with international dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. International dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards can be appealing options, but pregnant women need to be cautious when consuming them. In this article, we will analyze food safety for pregnant women with these international dishes.

## Food Safety Analysis
According to the CDC and NHS, pregnant women should avoid consuming the following foods:
* Uncooked or unpasteurized sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed and unpasteurized salads
* Undercooked BBQ
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

However, if these dishes are cooked or pasteurized correctly, they can be safe and nutritious options for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Combination
To ensure adequate nutrition, pregnant women should combine these international dishes with other nutrient-rich foods. For example:
* Combine sushi with vegetables and fruits to increase vitamin and mineral intake
* Add protein like chicken or fish to salads to increase nutritional value
* Combine BBQ with vegetables and fruits to increase vitamin and mineral intake
* Add pasteurized soft cheese to dishes to increase calcium intake

## Foods to Avoid
Pregnant women should avoid consuming the following foods:
* Uncooked or unpasteurized sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed and unpasteurized salads
* Undercooked BBQ
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety for pregnant women, remember:
* Always check the origin and quality of food
* Cook or pasteurize food correctly
* Wash hands and utensils before preparing food
* Avoid consuming expired or spoiled food

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women have any questions or concerns about food safety, they should seek help from their doctor or a nutrition expert. They can provide specific advice and guidance to ensure food safety for pregnant women.

## Additional Resources
To learn more about food safety for pregnant women, visit our [blog](/blog) or [meal planner](/planner) for more information.

## Conclusion
Food safety for pregnant women is crucial. By choosing safe and nutritious food, pregnant women can ensure the health and development of their baby. Remember to always check the origin and quality of food, cook or pasteurize food correctly, and avoid consuming expired or spoiled food.
